title: Unit cost
description: What one unit of an observed trace costs, in one country, at one time. This is the bridge between a count and a sum of money, and it is where an estimate is most easily attacked. Every entry is sourced, dated and versioned; an unsourced unit cost is rejected rather than queued. Entries live in mapomo/reference-data under CC-BY-4.0.

observedType.description: Must match the observedType it prices.

priceRange.description: Observed spread for this unit. Real markets are not a single number, and an estimate that ignores the spread understates its own uncertainty.

validity.description: Period the price applies to. Prices during a campaign period are frequently not the list prices of the rest of the year.

scope.description: Where and to whom the price applies. A national average that hides a threefold urban to rural gap is worse than no figure.

priceBasis.description: How the price was established. Published rate cards are frequently a ceiling rather than what is actually paid, which is why field-surveyed prices outrank them in confidence.

discountFactor.description: Multiplier applied to a list price to reflect what is actually paid, where that gap is known. Requires its own source.
